function.name: DRAW_RECT
function.param: Horizontal coordinate of the first point
Vertical coordinate of the first point
Horizontal coordinate of the second point
Vertical coordinate of the second point

description.p: It draws a rectangle between two spots, using the chosen colour with , in the chosen graph by the last call to . A rectangle has four lines (two verticales and two horizontals) and it is not filled. It is valid to specify coordinates out of the limits of the graph, but the picture will cut off over these.
